summary.text: Harry Niska is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 31A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he was elected GOP Floor Leader on February 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Harry Niska earned a B.A. in political science from Concordia College at Moorhead and a J.D. from the University of Minnesota, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Niska assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Kurt Daudt.
In the 2025-2026 session he is co-chair of the Rules and Legislative Administration Committee.
